fixed_vs_float.rationale: k in Q15: 0.6 -> 19661 (0.2 LSB off), -0.3 -> -9830 (0.4 LSB off), |dk| = 0.45 LSB; times |x| <= 1 gives <= 0.45 LSB, plus output rounding 0.5 LSB per component (0.71 LSB complex): <= 1.16 LSB = 3.5e-5. Measured 2.8e-5. SNR minimum: about 3 dB below the real-constant case's rounding-only level, for the constant's error.

As q15_nearest, but truncation costs up to 1 LSB per component (1.41 LSB complex): <= 1.86 LSB = 5.7e-5. Measured 5.0e-5. SNR minimum: about 3 dB below the real-constant case's rounding-only level, for the constant's error.

k in Q17 is off by <= 0.5 Q17 LSB per component (0.71 complex), times |x| <= 1, plus 0.71 Q17 LSB output rounding: <= 1.42 Q17 LSB = 1.08e-5. Measured 6.8e-6. SNR minimum: about 3 dB below the real-constant case's rounding-only level, for the constant's error.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Both compute the complex product in float32; the order of the four products and two sums differs (measured 4.2e-8).
